Void Carrier is a part of the Cerebral Puzzle Showcase!

The event takes place from May 29th to June 5th.
Be sure to check out the other amazing puzzle games.

notes.title: Play Void Carrier Demo as part of PixElated Festival!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44995255/7c283960f10786748793ab3b53e8e5b58e1e6b43.png[/img]
We love pixel art games, and we know you do too. So, let’s celebrate together 🎉 We’re super excited to share that Void Carrier joins PixElated Festival next week! This festival is featuring some of the best pixel art games on Steam. From retro-style classics to contemporary indie gems all in one place!

There will be ✨ discounts ✨ live streams ✨ art contest ✨ demos✨ developer chats ✨ all centered around your favorite games.

Check out the official line-up and more information about the event here: http://pixelatedfest.com/
